R4A-moose-drive-0004.name: 720 m NE of King Solomon Mountain
R4A-moose-drive-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4A-moose-drive-0004.parkWhat: pull off on Horse Creek (gravel road)

evidence.t: 9 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 1.9 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2011 (15 years old), right here: browse.
Moose winter range u-8-007 unit 3 (official), right here. Counts from November.

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1; spike fork bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 128 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.49608, -119.07937, pull off on Horse Creek (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 250 m NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-12, Region 8. Season: moose spike fork bulls Nov 1 to Nov 15 (synopsis page 68, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-moose-drive-0004.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 8-12: about 2,482 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.10 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 2 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
